scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run test:e2e
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format
scripts.content:backup:production: cd apps/studio && sanity dataset export production production-backup.tar.gz
scripts.content:export:development: cd apps/studio && sanity dataset export development development-export.tar.gz
scripts.content:promote: npm run content:backup:production && npm run content:export:development && cd apps/studio && sanity dataset import development-export.tar.gz production --replace
scripts.content:export:development: cd apps/studio && sanity dataset export development development.tar.gz --overwrite
scripts.content:export:production: cd apps/studio && sanity dataset export production production.tar.gz --overwrite
scripts.content:diff: npm run content:export:development && npm run content:export:production && node scripts/sanity-diff.mjs
